decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Dark Depths combo by using cards like Crop Rotation and Elvish Reclaimer to find the combo pieces. It also utilizes ramp cards like Mox Diamond and Green Sun's Zenith to accelerate its game plan. The deck includes cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Sylvan Library to provide additional utility and card advantage to help the player dig for combo pieces. The deck also includes cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending for removal, as well as cards like Bojuka Bog for graveyard hate.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck utilizes cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Sudden Edict to counter threats and remove key permanents, while also leveraging card draw and selection from cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration. The deck also aims to lock the opponent out of the game with cards like Hullbreacher and Narset, Parter of Veils, while closing out the game with powerful finishers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Lightning Bolt.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. It also aims to maintain tempo and card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. The mana base includes key lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base and Mystic Sanctuary to recur important spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, control the game through disruption, and close out the game quickly.

The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategies while generating card advantage through efficient answers and card draw. This is achieved through a combination of counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, and card advantage engines like Snapcaster Mage and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher to further hinder the opponent's card advantage. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and Supreme Verdict to close out the game.

The main concept of this combo Doomsday Legacy deck is to efficiently control and manipulate the top of the deck to set up a game-winning combo with Doomsday. Utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Dark Ritual, the deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for a successful Doomsday pile, which typically involves stacking the top of the deck with Thassa's Oracle and ensuring victory when it enters the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption tools like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's game plan.

The deck aims to control the game by using lands to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through cards like Life from the Loam and Urza's Saga. It utilizes a mix of utility lands, land destruction, and combo pieces like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create advantageous board states. The deck can adapt to different situations with cards like Crop Rotation and Punishing Fire, making it a versatile and resilient control archetype that can overwhelm opponents with a combination of disruption and powerful land-based threats.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly developing a threatening board presence with aggressive creatures. By combining counterspells like Daze and Force of Will with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their resources. The deck also utilizes card selection spells like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration to find the right tools for any given situation, ultimately leading to a fast and powerful tempo game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent and control the game tempo by utilizing fast and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence with aggressive creatures and spells, while also maintaining card advantage and selection with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is streamlined to support the low casting cost spells and ensure consistency in playing threats and disruptive cards.

This Control deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines like Uro and Narset. The deck includes a variety of versatile cards to handle different situations, along with powerful finishers like Entreat the Angels and Timeless Dragon. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolored spells and maximize consistency. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a versatile companion option, providing additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to out-value and out-manipulate opponents to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifact creatures and various artifacts to quickly generate tokens, ramp up mana, and control the board. By combining aggressive creatures like Sai, Master Thopterist and Kappa Cannoneer with powerful artifact cards like Urza's Saga and Mox Opal, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and strategic playstyle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch provides recursion for key artifacts, while cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will help disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, this deck focuses on synergy, speed, and versatility to gain the upper hand in Legacy matches.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence with artifact creatures and utilize various artifacts to generate mana and card advantage. By playing aggressive threats like Sai, Master Thopterist and Kappa Cannoneer alongside efficient mana ramp like Urza's Saga and Mox Opal, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature pressure and disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. Emry, Lurker of the Loch provides recursion and card filtering, while Thought Monitor offers card draw and additional threats. The deck's efficient use of artifacts and mana acceleration allows it to quickly close out games and outpace opponents.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies while applying pressure through aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, Spirit of the Labyrinth, and Skyclave Apparition, it aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and control the board. The deck also includes Aether Vial and Stoneforge Mystic to help accelerate its game plan and efficiently deploy threats. With a mix of hatebears and powerful equipment like Batterskull and Umezawa's Jitte, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and overwhelm them with its disruptive creatures and efficient equipment.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands as control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources. It uses cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration to repeatedly play and reuse key lands like Wasteland and Urza's Saga. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's mana base with cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland while also threatening a quick win with the Dark Depths-Thespian's Stage combo. It can grind out victories through attrition and card advantage, with Crucible of Worlds and Punishing Fire providing additional value.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to efficiently ramp up mana production while also having access to various utility lands for protection and removal. The main strategy involves using cards like Crop Rotation and Knight of the Reliquary to find key lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck also has access to creature removal and card draw options to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly play creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to control the board.
